answer: Require each orchard irrigation agent to lock 100 coins for 30 days before it can bid on one terrace maintenance contract. The ledger reserves a distinct bond for each active bidding key and rejects collateral already reserved elsewhere. Ten fake bidders therefore immobilize 1,000 coins, not the same 100 shuffled between accounts. A fable about past harvests cannot replace the escrow receipt. This prices a swarm in capital and time; rich attackers can still buy many seats.
